name: slipstream
description: Cut AI coding token burn by shrinking per-call context, not output, while keeping every skill reachable. By Lex from SigmaStudioz.

interface.shortDescription: Same work, a fraction of the tokens
interface.longDescription: Measures where tokens actually go in Claude Code and Codex logs (and Cursor's usage export), then shrinks the context re-sent on every call: a usage-based skill listing with a searchable catalog and prompt-time skill hints, a context meter that suggests handoffs at task boundaries, and a guard that replaces model-driven polling with one shell wait. All helpers run locally; configuration changes are dry-run by default and fully reversible.
